ReportQueryDefinition.Name: Формирование почтового реестра ф.103
ReportQueryDefinition.Command: SELECT m.id AS mail_id, m.outgoing_number AS out_num, m.date_dispatched AS dispatch_date, c.name AS recipient_name, m.to_zip AS recipient_zip, CONCAT_WS(', ', m.to_str6, m.to_str5, m.to_str2, m.to_str3, m.to_str4) AS recipient_address, m.weight AS item_weight, m.declared_value AS item_value, m.fee AS item_fee, m.russian_post_id AS barcode FROM mails m JOIN counterparties c ON m.counterparty_id = c.id WHERE m.sender_id = :SenderId AND m.date_created BETWEEN :DateFrom AND :DateTo AND (:MailCategory IS NULL OR m.mail_category = :MailCategory) AND m.status != 4 ORDER BY m.id ASC;

SELECT m.id AS mail_id, m.outgoing_number AS out_num, m.date_dispatched AS dispatch_date, c.name AS recipient_name, m.to_zip AS recipient_zip, (COALESCE(m.to_str6 || ', ', '') || COALESCE(m.to_str5 || ', ', '') || COALESCE(m.to_str2, '')) AS recipient_address, m.weight AS item_weight, m.declared_value AS item_value, m.fee AS item_fee, m.russian_post_id AS barcode FROM mails m JOIN counterparties c ON m.counterparty_id = c.id WHERE m.sender_id = :SenderId AND m.date_created BETWEEN :DateFrom AND :DateTo AND (:MailCategory IS NULL OR m.mail_category = :MailCategory) AND m.status != 4 ORDER BY m.id ASC;
